[{"word":"spice","pronun":"[spaɪs]","translation":"n. 香料；情趣；调味品；少许

adj. 螺旋形的；盘旋的
vt. 使成螺旋形；使作螺旋形上升
vi. 盘旋；成螺旋形；螺旋形上升（过去式spiraled/spiralled，过去分词spiraled/spiralled，现在分词spiraling/spiralling，第三人称单数spirals，副词spirally）","audio":"spiral.mp3"},{"word":"spite","pronun":"[spaɪt]","translation":"n. 不顾；恶意；怨恨
vt. 刁难；使恼怒","audio":"spite.mp3"},{"word":"splash","pronun":"[splæʃ]","translation":"n. 飞溅的水；污点；卖弄

vi. 溅湿；溅开","audio":"splash.mp3"},{"word":"spoil","pronun":"[spɔɪl]","translation":"n. 次品；奖品

vt. 和…结婚","audio":"spouse.mp3"},{"word":"sprinkle","pronun":"[ˈsprɪŋkl]","translation":"n. 撒，洒；少量

vi. 洒，撒；下稀疏小雨；喷撒","audio":"sprinkle.mp3"},{"word":"spy","pronun":"[spaɪ]","translation":"n. 间谍；密探

vi. 压榨","audio":"squeeze.mp3"},{"word":"stab","pronun":"[stæb]","translation":"n. 刺；戳；尝试；突发的一阵
